title: Spain Lets Anti-Money Laundering Unit Freeze Crypto Accounts Without a Judge
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Spain Lets Anti-Money Laundering Unit Freeze Crypto Accounts Without a Judge A royal decree lets Sepblac, Spain's financial intelligence unit, freeze crypto, bank and payment accounts for up to five business days without a court order. This post Spain Lets Anti-Money Laundering Unit Freeze Crypto Accounts Without a Judge first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
